title: 1. Hook: The Mystery of the Home Team
description: Have you ever wondered who those people are living in the same house as you? You eat together, play together, and sometimes even fight over toys! But what makes you all a special team?

title: 2. Socratic Thinking: What do you think?
description: If you were a baby bird in a nest, who would bring you food and keep you warm when it rains? Think about it!

content.title: 3. Discovery: The Family Tree Magic
content.description: Just like a strong tree has roots, a trunk, and many branches, you have parents, grandparents, and maybe brothers and sisters! You are a bright, growing leaf on this beautiful tree.

title: 4. Reveal: What is a Family?
description: A family is a group of people who are related to each other. They live together, love, care for, and help one another every day.

content.question: 5. Knowledge Check: Who among the following is usually a part of your family?

content.title: 6. Reflection: Your Family Picture
content.description: Close your eyes and think about all the people who live in your house. Now, explain to your friend or teacher who makes you laugh the most in your family and why!

content.title: 7. Connection: Animal Families
content.description: Did you know that elephants also live in families? The oldest female elephant is the leader, and the whole family works together to protect the baby elephants, just like your family protects you!

content.title: Wait a minute...
content.description: Sometimes we think only people who live in our house are our family. But remember, uncles, aunts, and cousins who live far away are also part of your big family!

content.title: 8. Mastery: The Family Helper Challenge
content.description: Today's challenge: Do one helpful thing for someone in your family! You can help set the dinner table, bring a glass of water, or give your grandparents a big hug.
